name: Home Assistant

database.label: Bundled SQLite for the recorder/history component by default; MariaDB or PostgreSQL recommended for larger installs with many entities

resourceFootprint.notes: 1 GB RAM / 1 core is a reasonable baseline for a home with 100+ entities across 1000+ available integrations. Footprint grows with the number of active integrations, automations, history retention and add-ons (e.g. running a local voice assistant or Zigbee/Z-Wave stacks in the same host).

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    container_name: homeassistant
    restart: unless-stopped
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - ha-config:/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
      - /run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro

volumes:
  ha-config:
descriptionEn: Home Assistant is a local-first, privacy-focused home automation platform backed by the Open Home Foundation, supporting over 1,000 integrations across virtually every smart-home brand and protocol (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, Thread). It runs entirely on your own hardware, keeps automations working even without internet access, and never requires a cloud subscription.
descriptionBg: Home Assistant е локална, ориентирана към поверителността платформа за домашна автоматизация, подкрепяна от Open Home Foundation, поддържаща над 1000 интеграции с почти всяка марка и протокол за smart home (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, Thread). Работи изцяло на собствения ти хардуер, поддържа автоматизациите активни дори без интернет и никога не изисква облачен абонамент.
taglineEn: Local, privacy-first home automation with 1000+ integrations.
taglineBg: Локална домашна автоматизация, ориентирана към поверителността, с над 1000 интеграции.
